header: EXPERIMENT (29 Sep 2026): natural-language -> read-only SQL, written by the LLM itself. Everything under src/lib/nl2sql, src/app/api/nl2sql and src/app/nl2sql-lab is NEW and ISOLATED: it imports nothing from the omnibar's employee-query engine and nothing imports it. I left the existing files (parser.ts, namePredicate.ts, queryOrchestrator.ts ...) untouched; they are dormant with respect to this feature.

symbols.name: SqlClient
doc: The minimal DB client the executor needs. It is injected, so tests can use a plain `pg` Client and production can use a dedicated connection.

members.name: query
members.sig: query(text: string, params?: any[]): Promise<{ rows: any[]; fields?: { name: string }[] }>;
members.returns: Promise<{ rows: any[]; fields?: { name: string }[] }>

symbols.name: LlmPlan
doc: This is what I require the LLM to return.

members.name: sql
doc: One read-only SELECT; null means the question can't be answered.

members.name: understood_as
doc: A plain-English restatement shown to the person ("Understood as").

members.name: needs_clarification
doc: I set this when the question is too ambiguous to answer safely.

members.name: unanswerable_reason
doc: Set when sql is null, to say why the data can't answer this.

members.name: out_of_scope
doc: Set to true when the question is not about employees at all (circulars, policies, holidays ...).

members.name: display
doc: Only the model's optional SUGGESTION for presenting the result: display.ts verifies it, since anything may be in here.

members.name: total
doc: Total rows the query produces; the rows I show may be capped for display.

members.name: truncated
doc: True when more rows exist beyond this page.

members.name: pageable
doc: True when the query has a total order, so I can fetch a further page consistently (paging.ts).

symbols.name: DepartmentScope
doc: The departments an answer's department filter matched; the system computes them from the SQL.

symbols.name: PipelineResult
symbols.sig: | { ok: true; question: string; sql: string; understoodAs: string; confidence: LlmPlan["confidence"]; data: QueryResultData; scope: DepartmentScope | null; display?: unknown; source: "nl2sql" | "cache"; verifiedBy?: number; spellingNote?: string; attempts: number; elapsedMs: number; logId: number | null; } | { ok: false; kind: "clarify" | "unanswerable" | "out_of_scope" | "error"; question: string; message: string; sql?: string | null; understoodAs?: string; attempts: number; elapsedMs: number; logId: number | null; }

symbols.name: LlmFn
doc: LLM adapter: takes the full prompt text and returns the raw model text.
